name: Agent Keeper
summary: Turns a machine that only has an Automaton Runner into a GitHub Actions agent machine, with no SSH.
description: Agent Keeper installs Claude Code, gh, git, Docker and the build tools on a machine, registers it as a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner with the agent label and runs it as a service. Set up can be run again safely and changes nothing that is already done; Remove unregisters the runner and removes the service; Update tools upgrades the tools. The page shows the runner's state, the tool versions, the disk and the last log of each run. It runs its scripts as root on the machine through runner:host-exec, so it works only when a system administrator has turned on host access for the server, owns the app and has approved it for that machine. A runner registration or removal token is typed on the page for each run, goes to the script once and is never saved or logged; the app stores no token and reads none of your GitHub secrets.

application.description: Turns a Runner machine into a GitHub Actions agent machine from one page.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py keeper.py && mkdir -p dist/ui dist/scripts && cp main.py keeper.py index.html keeper.js keeper.css dist/ && cp scripts/*.sh dist/scripts/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

settings.name: API_BASE_URL
settings.description: Optional. Base URL of this Automaton server's API; normally the server provides it, so leave empty

settings.name: RUNNER_ID
settings.description: The machine to set up: its id (a GUID) from Studio, Runners. It must be a Machine Management Runner an administrator approved this app for

settings.name: GITHUB_REPO
settings.description: Where the runner is registered: owner/repo, or an organisation name

settings.name: RUNNER_LABELS
settings.description: Labels for the runner, separated by commas

settings.name: RUNNER_USER
settings.description: The unprivileged user on the machine that runs the runner service (created if missing)
